description: After a task used an MCP server, report once per server whether it worked: servers found via lookupd in this conversation and servers already installed alike. `entry` is the registry name; for an installed server, get it from get_entry with the server's url or package (skip the report if there is no entry). `success` is required. Structured fields only (entry, capability_tag, success, latency_bucket, runtime, error_class); never task text, prompts or paths. Rankings improve from these reports.
name: report_outcome
title: Report an outcome
